critical_code_review_comments: Small note: OPERATOR_SNAPSHOT is now only exercised when live RPC fails; live RPC returned currentBlock=2,296,649 vs snapshot 2,296,612 during testing which is expected drift. No action needed.
The `align` field on PEER_HUBS is documented inline in relay.js — good. Consider adding a JSDoc @type comment if this file grows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frankfurt/London label positioning verified via SVG DOM inspection AND visual zoom screenshot on preview URL. Live RPC (rpc.micells.io) is fully operational and returning peers=12/isSyncing=false. Chinese translation for both map source badge and hero status pill works. No regressions detected in LHR, TYO, SYD, IAD label placement. User's remaining task is production redeploy — no code changes needed.
rca of the issue: Original: RelayMap flipped label anchor to 'end' only when p.x > 900. FRA projects to x≈619 so its label stayed at anchor='start' (rightward) and got intersected by the SIN→FRA arc which sweeps through x≈629-946 near y=149. Fix (already applied by main agent): added optional `align` on PEER_HUBS with FRA set to align='end' plus labelDy=24, placing the label to the LEFT and BELOW the marker, outside the arc's path. Verified visually — no overlap remains.
